name: Station vending nook (drink machine + coffee machine + locker + LED strip)

anchor.note: dx/dy are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint; the two vending machines stand side by side against the back wall with the locker and LED strip dressing the nook.

offset_basis_summary: Drink_Machine_Front and Coffee_Machine_Front are adjacent columns on the same row of the 20_Subway_and_Train_Station sheet (x16 and x80, y368), so that pair is sheet_relative. The small locker and LED strip live in unrelated sheet regions, so their placement is hand-authored.

pieces.notes: Stands beside the machines against the wall. Bugfix: footprint widened 4->6 tiles, machines' dy 1->0 (they were escaping the declared 3-tile-tall footprint) and locker dx 0->4 (the old dx=0/dy=0 placed it directly on top of the drink machine's own dx=0 column, a 50% solid/solid overlap that check-city-plan.py OVERLAP flags) — the extra 2 tiles of width give the locker its own column clear of both machines.
Wall-mounted accent light above the coffee machine.

variants.machine_count: Either machine can be dropped for a single-vendor nook.
variants.led_state: Swap for led_light_off for an unlit/broken fixture.

notes: Sheet-relative vending-machine pair (both *_front variants share y=368) dressed with a hand-placed locker and LED accent so the nook reads as a stocked station corner.
